gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla brings wide, barely curled s curves and a short climb to its ascenders, a plain sans that feels friendly and current. Plakkaat sits beside it, heavy and closed.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-devanagari: Open letter mouths and a tall middle zone give Anek Devanagari a modern, unfussy sans-serif feel. And Plakkaat's closed, heavy shapes make the gap between the two the pair's best feature.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-gujarati: Plakkaat hits hard, with bent-straw lines and joins as slim as a pipe cleaner, closed up tight and bold. Anek Gujarati, a sans with a gaping c, reads openly and easily.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Professional and clean, Anek Gurmukhi gives every small letter a big open counter and generous round curves. But Plakkaat, heavy and closed, earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-kannada: Contemporary and modern, Anek Kannada lifts its x-height high like a squared woodblock letter, with terminals stopping well away from the stem. And over a longer passage it reads brisk and open, a sharp foil to Plakkaat's closed weight.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-latin: Plakkaat stamps out heavy letters drawn with one fixed nib width, their terminals curling nearly back to the stem. And Anek Latin, a sans-serif with tall lowercase held open, handles the quieter reading.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-malayalam: Clean and contemporary, Anek Malayalam sets its lowercase close to the caps, with curve tips that never touch. Plakkaat is the one for bold, heavy statements, while Anek Malayalam handles the sans-serif reading.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-odia: Clean and contemporary, Anek Odia leaves its rounds unlatched. Plakkaat's heavy, closed forms take the front of the page, and the plain sans body keeps its capitals only slightly above lowercase.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-tamil: Big round bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes make Anek Tamil read modern and open, a sans with room to breathe. Anek Tamil sits under Plakkaat's dowel-stiff, heavy lettering like a loosened version of it.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-telugu: Plakkaat's heavy letters curl their terminals nearly back to the stem, so they look sealed and bold. Anek Telugu answers with wide, tall bowls left unlatched, and you can size it freely for comfort.
